context-coverage.note: 22 contexts across 7 groups in context-map.json; audit.ok true. No in-repo work needed — the scan is the app's job.

agent-instructions.note: Root CLAUDE.md carries verified commands, crate-tree sketch and the dependency rule; .claude/CLAUDE.md remains the policy file.

documentation.note: 15 feature docs coupled to source globs and enforced per-session. catalog/ and plugins-src/ entries are inert pending a SKIP_PATTERNS change in the checker.

agent-memory.note: Root MEMORY.md now indexes the .perfect/ vault plus five verified invariants, so memory survives outside one machine.

skills.note: Seven skills tracked in-repo: architect, perfect, passport-onboard, explorer, tiger, ship-loop, research. UI/desktop-specific skills deliberately not adopted.

hosting.note: Local-first by design: loopback bind, single-file SQLite, real Chrome and a browser profile with login cookies. Containerization deliberately declined.

database.note: 20 ordered migrations applied at startup, now preceded by an automatic VACUUM INTO backup with keep-3 retention and guarded by a replay test.

auth.note: No inbound auth; posture documented explicitly with the loopback precondition. Binding to a non-loopback interface without adding auth is unsafe.

ci.note: fmt, clippy -D warnings and the full test suite now fail the build; a weekly cargo-deny audit runs alongside. Branch protection is a server-side setting still to be enabled.

tests.note: Roughly 390 tests across all workspace crates plus an in-crate e2e suite; env-dependent tests stay behind #[ignore] and do not run in CI.

evals.note: Golden-fixture eval over the tier-3 extraction path: 10 real frozen pages with recorded transcripts, scored offline, with adversarial-mutation tests proving it can fail.

observability.note: SDK wired at the server entry point, env-tagged, release-stamped, degrading silently without a DSN. Errors only; no performance tracing, no PII. Credential binding still outstanding.

llm-tracking.note: All model calls funnel through one chokepoint carrying cache, budget clamp and cost metering; enforced structurally by visibility plus an inventory guard. No vendor tracing tool.

security.note: Supply-chain audit in CI with two advisories fixed and two waived explicitly with stated exposure; request bodies now bounded. License gate written but not yet enforced.

app-cost.note: Ledger composed from this run's connector decisions; kept local and untracked by design.
